_meta.source: ZED official registry, NIC Divisions 10-12 (Food, Beverage, Tobacco)
_meta.important_note: This data covers ONLY food/beverage/tobacco sectors, not all ZED MSMEs.

qa_pairs.q: How many MSMEs are in this dataset / registered under ZED for food, beverage and tobacco?
qa_pairs.a: There are 93,363 MSMEs registered under ZED in the food, beverage and tobacco sectors (NIC 10-12).

qa_pairs.q: How many are certified vs just registered?
qa_pairs.a: 49,536 are Certified and 43,827 are Registered (pledge taken, not yet certified).

qa_pairs.q: How many Bronze, Silver and Gold certified units are there?
qa_pairs.a: Bronze: 50,855 units. Silver: 1,052 units. Gold: 611 units. Most units stop at Bronze.

qa_pairs.q: Which states have the most ZED MSMEs in these sectors?
qa_pairs.a: Top 5 states: KARNATAKA (14,140), BIHAR (13,562), GUJARAT (8,231), UTTAR PRADESH (7,891), PUNJAB (5,474).

qa_pairs.q: How many women-owned MSMEs are there?
qa_pairs.a: 22,282 units are women-owned, about 24% of the total.
81,706 units (88%) are Micro enterprises; the rest are Small and Medium.

qa_pairs.q: Which sectors are covered and how many in each?
qa_pairs.a: 10-Manufacture of food products: 80,678; 12-Manufacture of tobacco products: 7,216; 11-Manufacture of beverages: 5,469.
